Rebuild the analysable table from the journals

Source: R/journal.R
fishmorph_consolidate.Rd

For each key (row_key), only the LAST record is kept – maximum timestamp, maximum record_id in case of a tie. Earlier records stay in the journals: they are the history of corrections, readable through fm_journal_history(), and they are never lost.

Usage

fishmorph_consolidate(
  journal_dir,
  long = FALSE,
  drop_na_points = TRUE,
  out_csv = NULL,
  out_xlsx = NULL
)

Arguments

journal_dir

Journal directory, or an already-read data.frame.

long

TRUE -> return the long format kept (one row per point) instead of the wide table.

drop_na_points

TRUE (default) -> points marked "na" come out as NA. FALSE -> whatever coordinates they carry are kept.

out_csv, out_xlsx

Optional export paths (the xlsx one requires openxlsx).

Value

A wide data.frame: one row per key, columns <n>_X / <n>_Y.
